name: navilet-video
description: Ролики для navilet.ru: сцены из src/components/video, рендер Remotion

scripts.render:zayavka: remotion render src/index.ts Zayavka out/zayavka.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26 && remotion render src/index.ts Zayavka out/zayavka.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=36
scripts.render:hero: remotion render src/index.ts HeroPro out/hero-pro.mp4 --public-dir ../public --codec=h264 --crf=26 && remotion render src/index.ts HeroPro out/hero-pro.webm --public-dir ../public --codec=vp9 --crf=36
scripts.render:how: remotion render src/index.ts HowItWorks out/how-it-works.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26 && remotion render src/index.ts HowItWorks out/how-it-works.webm --codec=vp9 --crf=36 && remotion still src/index.ts HowItWorks out/how-it-works-poster.jpg --frame=330 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=82
